edit.description: a freed slot re-reads the queue and re-selects from it, skipping an attempted set rather than splicing a wave-start snapshot, and reads the stop flag beside the teardown signal when the tick is supervised
the tick is told whether it runs under a supervisor, on the surface already carrying the supervisor's identity across that boundary
the `tick` command states that fact from what the supervisor told it, beside the claim-inheritance decode
the mid-wave higher-priority pull, the supervised mid-wave stop, the bare-tick refill across the flag, and the never-re-picked pin, beside the wave's refill cases

summary: A freed slot refills from the wave-start snapshot and reads only the teardown signal, so an entry filed mid-wave waits out the whole queue and a flag written mid-run stops nothing

per.section: Fanout and worktrees — provisioning, isolation, teardown

acceptance: a freed slot reads the queue as it stands and re-selects in priority order, skipping every entry this wave has attempted, so an entry filed mid-wave at a higher priority is pulled ahead of lower-ranked work the wave started with and the wave ends when nothing it has not attempted is pickable; and a slot freed under a supervisor reads the stop flag off disk through the reader the supervisor already spends, pulling nothing more once it is present while every in-flight entry finishes and merges, where a bare `flume tick`'s wave refills across it
tests: a wave pulls an entry filed mid-wave at a higher priority before a lower-ranked one it started with
a supervised wave pulls nothing more once the stop flag is written while a slot's agent runs
pins: a wave never pulls an entry it has already attempted
a bare tick's wave refills a freed slot with the stop flag present
notes: Rulings 68eba4eb, e74af849. `fillSlots` (`src/waveTick.ts:386`) picks from `remaining` (`:249`), the wave-start snapshot, guarding on `leg.attemptCtx.stopSignal` alone (`:390`); `readPendingForDecision` (`:79`) with `leg.selection` (`:116`) is the re-read, `existsLoud(stopFlagPath(flumeDir))` (`src/loopSupervisor.ts:908`) the flag reader. `fillSlots` stays sync: await the re-read in the settling slot. Supervised is told, never inferred off `ownTipClaimPid` (`src/cli.ts:1030`).
